name: codex-chat-provider
description: VS Code Chat language models via OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT subscription OAuth. Reuses ~/.codex or Pi openai-codex login — no API key.

openaiCodex.authPreference.markdownDescription: Token source: **auto** = VS Code Secret Storage (Command Palette sign-in) → `~/.codex/auth.json` → Pi. **secret** = palette only.

openaiCodex.writeCodexAuthFile.markdownDescription: After Command Palette sign-in, also write `~/.codex/auth.json` so Codex CLI can reuse the session if installed later.

openaiCodex.codexAuthPath.description: Optional override path to Codex CLI auth.json (default: ~/.codex/auth.json).

openaiCodex.piAuthPath.description: Optional override path to Pi auth.json (default: ~/.pi/agent/auth.json).

openaiCodex.clientVersion.markdownDescription: Client version for `GET /codex/models`. Empty = read `~/.codex/version.json` or default `0.146.0`.

openaiCodex.hideHiddenModels.description: Hide models with visibility=hide from the picker.

openaiCodex.defaultThinkingLevel.markdownDescription: Fallback reasoning effort. Per-model defaults prefer **medium** when available, or **high** for off→high ladders (Agents use the schema default).

openaiCodex.defaultMaxTokens.markdownDescription: Max output tokens override. **0 = auto** (derived from context window).

openaiCodex.refreshIntervalMinutes.description: How often to re-fetch models (0 = on demand only).
